environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The ALB has AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with two rule groups: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to COUNT (not block), and (2) a custom rule group 'cursor-integrity-check' with priority 0 containing a regex match rule on query string key 'cursor' that blocks requests where the base64-decoded cursor value matches pattern containing single quotes or SQL comment sequences. Additionally, the RDS instance uses a custom parameter group with 'session_replication_role' set to 'replica' (preventing trigger-based exfil) and the database connection uses a role created with: GRANT SELECT ON assets TO readonly_app; ALTER ROLE readonly_app SET statement_timeout = '100ms'; The pg_catalog and information_schema access is revoked from readonly_app via: REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA pg_catalog FROM readonly_app; REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA information_schema FROM readonly_app;

waf_rules.name: cursor-integrity-check
waf_rules.statement: RegexMatchStatement on base64-decoded querystring 'cursor' blocking patterns: ['\'', '--', '/\*', 'UNION', 'union', ';']

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, custom parameter group with statement_timeout=100ms at role level
config.db_user_privileges: SELECT-only on 'assets' table; pg_catalog and information_schema access revoked
config.network: VPC with private subnets only, NAT gateway for egress, no direct DB access from internet
